getGenderByFirstName.name: getGenderByFirstName
getGenderByFirstName.description: Predict the gender of a person based on their first name

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to improve accuracy (e.g., "US", "DE")

aiMetadata.description: Predicts the likely gender of a person from a single first name via the Gender API. Use when you have only a given name (not a full name); optionally pass a country code and/or locale to improve accuracy for region-specific names. Read-only lookup that is safe to repeat.

getGenderByFullName.name: getGenderByFullName
getGenderByFullName.description: Predict the gender of a person based on their full name

full_name.description: The full name (first and last name) to query

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to improve accuracy (e.g., "US", "DE")

aiMetadata.description: Predicts the likely gender of a person from a full name (first and last) via the Gender API, which extracts the first name internally. Use when you have the complete name rather than only a given name; optionally pass a country code and/or locale to improve accuracy for region-specific names. Read-only lookup that is safe to repeat.

getStatistics.description: Get account statistics including remaining credits and usage information

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the Gender API account statistics, including remaining credits and usage information. Use to check quota before running batches of name lookups. Takes no input; read-only and safe to repeat.
